With the help of our friends at [url=https://grajpopolsku.pl/]Graj Po Polsku[/url] we are happy to present you a full Polish localization of Phoning Home. A lot of care went into this translation and we hope that our Polish followers will enjoy the game as much as we do. Furthermore this update includes a series of small tweaks to avoid confusion after [spoiler]rescuing ANI from the skyscraper[/spoiler].

Celebrating this update and the upcoming summer, Phoning Home will be available for a [b]great discount for a 3 days[/b].

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/483acc414bdd07f9b406d668151dbaed68a1006d.jpg[/img]

Hello Explorers, 

In this update we bring a redesign of the desert environment as well as more changes implemented from player feedback. Thanks for all your friendly suggestions and your criticism. It is always appreciated. Phoning Home is a challenging experience, where the right path forward is not always obvious. The changes in this update mainly improve the flow of the game. You can find the full change list below.

There is one thing we would like to ask you today. If you enjoyed [b]Phoning Home[/b], we'd love it if you let us and others know by writing a review. Because we implemented a lot of improvements since the release, we would also like to ask those who had issues with the game before to re-evaluate and update their review. That would really help us to better know your experiences and continue development. [b]Thank you![/b] ːionː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/2e78076ee829a28a0119c826b42d481b0ad0b8ac.jpg[/img]

There are still a few changes in the pipeline. To name one, we are working on adding new languages. In this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/431650/discussions/0/1473095331493423902/]forum thread[/url] you can let us know which ones you'd like to see supported.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/5656327c2dd4c7be02883895037ee5201d8c2e67.jpg[/img]

[b]Full Change List:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved the autosave functionality to avoid saving right after loading a game or multiple saves right after each other.
[*]Added terrain borders to avoid falling over the edge of the world.
[*]Added an automatic move feature. Hit 'R' on the keyboard or 'Left Shoulder' on the controller to toggle it. Auto-Move is also disabled when hitting the backward move button or loading a savegame.
[*]Increased the default inventory capacity from 7 to 10 per item and from 10 to 20 after building the memory upgrade.
[*]Added more autosave triggers in the desert.
[*]Edited the desert terrain providing clearer guidance how to reach the southern radio tower.
[*]Added more visual cues in the desert to indicate potential paths to follow. Plus, it looks a lot more exciting wandering around the mountains and sand dunes. There are also a couple more shortcuts via portals.
[*]Portals that can be found on the planet are now marked on your compass including the distance.
[*]Tweaked the positions of several task markers.
[*]Added further improvements to the way ANI's following speed is calculated depending on her distance. She will now be able to catch up more quickly when she has to take one of her little detours to reach ION.
[*]Added visual improvements to the lava borders on the forest areas to make them stand out and avoid getting lost unnecessarily.
[*]Since some players missed the pipe after ION's crash landing, that was made more visible. Also added an icon to the pickup UI.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/2101fd8022eac756f50ee1a8772054fc49368a75.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NVIDIA Ansel integration - Create your own 360° screenshots
notes.content:
[h1]NVIDIA Ansel[/h1]
Ansel is an awesome tool to create wonderful screenshots. It allows to take full 360° shots. The easiest way to share them is via Facebook or Google Photos.

Check out this example. Click the image to view the full 360 on Google Photos.
[url=https://photos.google.com/share/AF1QipMPJUwZ_D-bihNlQyf8XfivTJMOiwxR2vYTeXwln1E0n4U44itH39RsYPXln35WuQ/photo/AF1QipNk23X9X-F7txD0XJnCyrO9SPaE13eRYnz4R9Ln?key=NW9QSmFrYTdrdURoZDQxd0UwYjZZQ25nMWtFa2VR][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/d6b63d673ecbded9b7fafa9319c2ac8ed8569797.jpg[/img][/url]

But that's not all. You can also take ultra high-res or VR screenshots and position the camera wherever you want. Here's what you have to do:
[list]
[*]Make sure to install the latest GeForce driver and check here if your GPU is supported:  http://www.geforce.com/hardware/technology/ansel/supported-gpus
[*]Play Phoning Home and press Alt+F2 (the default Ansel hotkey) during gameplay to open the Ansel interface. The game is now paused.
[*]Reposition the camera by using WASD and rotate with the mouse+LMB, change Ansel options as desired, apply any effects you want and click “Snap”.
[/list]

To adjust Ansel's internal settings, open the following tool:
C:\Program Files\NVIDIA Corporation\Ansel\Tools\NvCameraConfiguration.exe

[b]Show us your creative skills on Facebook:[/b]
https://www.facebook.com/phoninghomegame/


[h1]Story Hotfix[/h1]
We have implemented a fix for a bug which broke the story script when returning to the forest from the desert too early. 

As always, thanks everyone for your support.
Have fun!

notes.title: Spring Polish
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/cce0f943787337dad64e895c5cb8bea4c515b62d.jpg[/img]
We're in the middle of spring, so it's time to clean your vehicle to take it for a ride through the beautiful scenery. 

[b]Be like ION. Explore![/b]

There were some remaining bugs and annoyances that we wanted to take a bit longer to get right. ION's movement for example has always been a bit tricky, especially when moving and thrusting at the same time when facing obstacles. It has always been very physically correct, but it required a bit of discipline to stop hitting that forward move key when you try to thrust up a rock or some other obstacles. Well, the new movement mechanics do that for you now.
We also had to find a solution to avoid running into rocks, which was kind of an engine problem. That should be fixed now. 

Some of our most loyal fans found two major issues in the story and dialog logic, for which we are happy to provide a fix today. Thanks again for your help in reporting these issues and your continued support.

[b]Further Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Disabled hiding ION if the camera gets too close. This was originally implemented to avoid seeing only part of ION, but many reported it rather adding to the confusion than reducing it.
[*]Fixed a few typos in tooltips and library texts.
[*]Increased initial push of thruster.
[*]Made a couple of environment changes in the forest and the desert.
[*]Reduced the time of night.
[*]Tweaked the lighting everywhere at night.
[*]Added an option to select which monitor the game should run on.
[/list]

What would you like us to work on next? 
Your suggestions are welcome. Please let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
If you're using a controller or plan to do so, this update will make you happy.
Please let us know in the comments if you are a controller user and what you think about the changes! Thank you.

[b]UI Revision[/b]
We've redesigned the controls and user interface to make using controllers much more user friendly. The game now detects whether a controller button or stick was used and switches to the controller UI automatically. You can intuitively switch back between keyboard+mouse and controller by using the respective input device.
The controller actions are now displayed on the UI.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/4e19a70f3740bded492c8f6d08242e982e85da1e.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/2d1ce32eb6e461dca51ebdc0c429d207967839ef.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/dac94e60647eb936103ebfdf6418c669ddfe7cca.png[/img]

When no window is open, you can use DPad up and down to quickly switch between the available tools (Teleporter, Photon Pulse, Attractor etc.). 
The inventory window has undergone a more elaborate revision. Tooltips are now removed, infos about selected items are now displayed on the left. Crafting items is now very easy with a controller use DPad Left/Right to cycle through the items available for crafting and hit X to craft.
Furthermore, all items are selectable with the controller now to read about their details. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/d658a37742a949ef703f9cd88efc73e115d3b4a5.jpg[/img]

We made sure that selected items are properly visible, especially in the savegame window.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/4602fd56108cfe56ed9051af37afd30410c93003.png[/img]

[b]Sprint Mode[/b]
Sprint mode is now visualized by a small symbol above your stats. It also comes with a sound when you enable or disable it. Also, the sprint mode status is now stored in savegames.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/04f07a9edd52344946ea77666fef6dd708e48892.png[/img]

[b]Character Dialogue Improvements[/b]
Dialogue for ION's or ANI's death has been fixed and has no more delay caused by other dialogue chains getting finished before. Also, after death no other dialogue is played anymore. After all, we have no proof yet whether robots have an afterlife.
Furthermore, the timing of dialogue is now better in some situations where it felt delayed. Very short lines sometimes caused a bug that made them barely readable.

[b]Other Changes and Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a couple of rare exceptions and errors that the crash reporter sent our way during the last 2 weeks.
[*]Reduced the forced delay from one scan to the next. This was not intended to block the player, just to prevent bugs from scanning resources too frantically.
[*]Fixed a bug that would prevent updating the thruster Steam achievements in certain conditions.
[*]Increased the speed at which the thruster is refilled with fuel.
[*]Added more resources in the starting forest area (Creonoble, Photonics and Thuranon).
[*]Fixed a bug that caused draining energy when sprint mode was active and standing still.
[*]Increased the size of the compass.
[/list]

[b]Happy controlling and exploring![/b]

notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

It's been nearly 3 months since the official release of Phoning Home here on Steam. The game has had a lot of changes since we put the first version live.
Thanks to you and your feedback we were able to improve the game - a survival story of the two robotic protagonists ION and ANI and their ships TR2 and Sister.

We want to celebrate the release of this [b]Version 1.1[/b] with a [b]33% DISCOUNT[/b] throughout the week. So get the game while it lasts!

[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]
If you own a powerful graphics card, the improved "Extreme" quality setting might be worth checking out. The range shadows are rendered has been increased a lot.
Also, the range in which objects are rendered at their highest detail is much higher than in the default "Very High" quality setting. Landscapes look very impressive on "Extreme", as you can see on this screenshot:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/856cf39892543f3ce16b9e11777b4d63c310ed01.jpg[/img]

Additionally we added new environment effects to the ocean and crater areas.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/e5d1a799efa454a5b75176f567bbd924d2236c92.jpg[/img]

[h1]Graphic Options[/h1]
The options window has been overhauled completely with new settings both for rendering and audio. There are new options to toggle bloom, SSAO (screen space ambient occlusion) and motion blur to adjust the game to your taste. Upon request we also added a slider the change the field of view (FOV) to a value between 60 and 90 (default is 60). 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/43e1d531e853d30ca695519e52b3d0362c287d90.png[/img]

[h1]Physics[/h1]
To reduce collision inaccuracies we've increased the frequency of physics updates in physical objects. According to our tests this shouldn't affect performance in any significant way, as there are not a whole lot of physical objects in the scenes. 

[h1]Sound and Translation[/h1]
We went over all of the voiceover sounds and tweaked the volume and improved the sound quality where applicable. Also, we had a few streamers and Youtubers express the wish to be able to separately adjust the volume of the voiceover. We added that and another setting for ANI's voice.
Additionally we added missing translations, fixed typos and other language errors. If you spot any errors in your playthroughs, we would be happy if you reported them in the support forum.

[h1]Performance[/h1]
To increase performance we have tweaked the LODs (levels of detail) for some of environment models and the texture sizes to reduce memory consumption on your graphics card.
Phoning Home still is a very modern game in terms of visual quality and detail. However, on lower end systems you can now gain a few more fps with the new graphics options,
like disabling some of the post processing effects like bloom and ssao (screen space ambient occlusion), even though we wouldn't recommend that because they look awesome.
Another option to gain fps is reducing the ground detail slider, this has proven to be very effective.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/ddd55074ceeffa9c7557694afcea8fc328ef9876.jpg[/img]

Besides a range of bug fixes this update includes a fix for a crash that would only happen when you quit the game right after you started it. We also increased the amount of visual effects in the desert, ocean and crater areas. Furthermore in all areas the navigation mesh was improved and extended, which is important for ANI to know where she can follow. However, if ANI does not follow, she just cannot reach the spot you currently are, mostly because the angle is too steep or there is no direct connection to your position. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/fc746dd80ccabe5fca98fa87a5141ba14c5d4ca9.jpg[/img]

[b]Happy exploration![/b]

notes.title: Update 6 - ANI, Speed, Balancing
notes.content:
After reading all your feedback in the forums, in your reviews and watching numerous Let's Plays we've come up with some more balancing improvements. Especially regarding ANI we wanted to make sure she is less of a burden.
That she sometimes moves in weird paths, however, is not something we can change everywhere, especially in the desert where the navigation mesh is very, very large. She also will not be able to move everywhere ION can, that's just how it is with her wheels. But what we can do is make her more robust when it comes to being a combat companion. She now takes less damage from falling or when getting attacked. She already takes enough damage from all the bad weather on the planet.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/04b5d98d1c777e6490e7c8e64745e9b3f21241d6.png[/img]

Full change list:
[list]
[*]Increased ANI's damage resistance (all kinds of damage).
[*]Reduced the length of night. It is now half as long as daytime.
[*]Added another 25% general movement speed increase for ION and ANI.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused showing "Not enough energy" for lamps and other devices in the desert in the German localization.
[*]Reduced energy consumption from sprint mode by 15%.
[*]Tetrerium is now displayed larger on the compass once detected by ANI.
[*]Fixed a bug that would sometimes disable lights within world portals or tumblers making them hard to see in the environment.
[*]Improved the sand worm to not only apply damage to a single target when rising out of the ground.
[/list]

Have a great weekend, fellow explorers!

notes.title: Update 5 - Controller Improvements, Desert terrain adjustments
notes.content:
This update comes with a number of fixes and improvements for players using a controller. Additionally we changed the terrain of the desert to create less confusion when it comes to these sediment lines you can see everywhere on the hills. Some of those looked like paths, but they were too steep to be climbable.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27418885/3b097ab4a9063e974077356dd0af99affc845fc2.jpg[/img]

Full change list:
[list]
[*][b]Important:[/b] On controllers the [b]B[/b] button now opens the Library (there was a control binding missing for this action). Since that button was previously bound to "Interact" (scanning resources, activating objects), interaction is now on the [b]A[/b] button. Please keep that in mind when you're using your controller after this update. We had to revert the control bindings to the defaults for internal reasons, apologies for that!
[*]Increased the highlights of UI objects, which is especially helpful for controller users as they don't have a mouse showing them exactly what element they are hovering.
[*]Fixed library handling for controllers. Scrolling down in the text box (if the text is longer than the box) is a bit tricky, though. To do that, controller users have to navigate all the way to the bottom of the list, then the text box gets focused and you can navigate down/up to scroll. To go back up to the list and select another library entry, navigate the stick to the left. For Keyboard+Mouse users everything stays the same, except they can now use the directional keys to scroll down the list of library entries.
[*]Fixed a bug when using the controller in the inventory and getting stuck after using a power-up, which required reopening the inventory.
[*]Fixed the resolution dropdown for controller users.
[*]Fixed a rare bug that would cause ION to fall through the ground on loading any savegame.
[*]Increased visibility of distant compass resource icons.
[*]Increased ANI's attack rate.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing Attractor or Memory Upgrade to get unlocked when specific events or triggers were skipped. Reload your savegames and they should be in your inventory ready to get crafted.
[*]Changed the desert terrain texturing and reduced the sediments that looked like "paths" but were too steep to climb. 
[/list]

Thanks to everyone for supporting Phoning Home! We wish you all a great weekend!

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
We have been acting like busy little tumblers for the past 2 days working to fix problems that you reported. The most important change is the addition of an autosave rotation system for your convenience when you run into trouble and have to load a previous game state. There are now 3 autosaves that you can choose from when ION or ANI dies. But we'd also like to make you aware that you can make up to 20 savegames of your own. We suggest to save often.
To do this quickly, there is also a quicksave option by hitting F5 to save and F9 to load it again.

Full change list:
[list]
[*]Changed crafting rules for Light Probe to require 2 x Crystal instead of Tetrerium and Plasma Charge to require 3 x Ferron instead of Tetrerium
[*]Fixed Thruster achievements (they were not progressing past 1)
[*]Added a rotating automatic save system, which always stores the last 3 autosaves that you can choose from when something unexpected happened
[*]Clicking "Retry" on the gameover screen will now open the load game menu
[*]Added more resources in the desert
[*]Fixed and improved the display of the guiding compass task markers
[*]Reduced ANIs fall damage by 20%
[*]Increased ANIs Plasma Charge damage by 25%
[*]Fixed a few typos
[*]Fixed a possible dead-end when first returning from the desert after the third sandstorm
[*]Fixed a problem with ANIs behavior in the ice cave
[*]Adjusted the volume of a series of voiceovers
[*]Fixed a dead end due to a wrong condition if ANI was found before Sister's CommArray was repaired
[*]Improved ANIs pathing through portals that ION made
[/list]

Now, time for you to continue your journey, fellow explorers. ːionː
